run.title: Louloupress New Features — Indexes, Article Metadata, Secret Posts, Reading Time, Menu Visibility

commit.subject: feat(content): add secret status, updated and readingTime frontmatter, visibility helpers
commit.body: Extend the shared content frontmatter schema with the `secret` status value and optional `updated` and `readingTime` fields, and add an `article-visibility` module centralizing the published/secret/draft/discoverable/directly-accessible predicates and `getArticleDisplayDate`. Backward compatible; no surface behavior changes yet. Covered by unit and frontmatter round-trip tests.

commit.subject: feat(content): exclude secret articles from discovery while keeping direct access
commit.body: Route every visibility check through the shared predicates so `secret` articles are directly accessible by URL with a `noindex, nofollow` directive yet excluded from indexes, tag pages, sitemap, RSS, content-index, generated usage indexes, and LLM files. Drafts keep their existing exclusion. Covered by route-data and build-artifact integration tests.

phases.title: Centralize visibility across discovery and direct-access surfaces

commit.subject: feat(content): add ArticleCard with date, tags, and reading-time labels
commit.body: Add a localized `card` copy block, a shared date-format util, and `getArticleDateLabel`/`getArticleReadingTimeLabel`, plus an `ArticleCard` that shows title, description, a Published/Updated date, tag labels, and reading time (each conditionally rendered). Covered by component and helper tests.

phases.title: Card copy, date/reading-time labels, and richer ArticleCard

commit.subject: feat(content): replace scope landing pages with chronological section-filtered index
commit.body: Add a scope-index route-data resolver and a `SectionFilteredIndexPage` that lists all discoverable articles in a scope newest-first (by publication date) with an `All` + per-section `?section=` filter bar, and wire the Fernand catch-all route to render it for scope-root pages while leaving normal pages on the MDX renderer. Empty sections are dropped from the filter. Covered by route-data integration tests and the prod smoke gate.

commit.subject: feat(site-core): add menu visibility control and empty-section hiding
commit.body: Add an optional `visibleInMenu` flag (default true) to main menu items and section taxonomy items, and hide sections with no published articles from the navigation resolver, injecting per-section published counts from the section usage runtime. Footer navigation built from the same tree inherits the behavior. Covered by navigation resolver and config tests.

commit.subject: chore(fernand): migrate content to readingTime/updated and hide preparatory sections
commit.body: Populate `readingTime` on published Fernand articles, add `updated` to revised ones, hide any preparatory sections from the menu via `visibleInMenu: false`, and regenerate the section/tag usage indexes, scope index pages, content-index, RSS, and LLM artifacts to match. No field is mandatory; existing content stays valid.

phases.title: Le Secrétaire de Fernand content migration
